Re-made card images from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' HiRez project: Two-Player Introductory Game cards re-coloured from a white to a black border, print-ready errata cards (fan re-sets with an "E" mark) and print-ready renders of Players Committee virtual cards. They are not scans of printed cards, so they are not shown or linked on card articles (decision of 28 November 2026). The files are kept as records of his project; see [[Strangewayes#Re-made cards]].

His real scans of printed cards are in [[:Category:High-res card scans]].
